freshness.volatility_notes: Android projection rules can change with API releases.

license.usage_notes: Use short paraphrases and link to Android Developers.

claims.claim: Android 14+ supports system-mediated capture of a selected app window; each MediaProjection session requires fresh user consent.
claims.location: App screen sharing and MediaProjection consent sections

claims.claim: The app must handle MediaProjection callbacks and release the session when stopped; Android 15 QPR1+ stops screen projection when the device is locked.
claims.location: MediaProjection.Callback and Android 15 QPR1 behavior sections
